name: Rich real agent comparison with Gemini 2.5 Flash

prompts: Fix summarizeInventory in src/inventory.mjs. Read the requirements in requirements.md and inspect the input fixture. Implement the change and write a short CHANGELOG.md. Work only in this task directory; do not install packages. Use whichever installed tools are useful. Complete without asking questions.

Now add selectLowStock(rows, threshold) to the same module. Use aggregate stock by SKU from summarizeInventory, return SKUs with quantity <= threshold, sorted alphabetically. Preserve the first function. Do not ask questions.

files.requirements.md: summarizeInventory(rows) returns an array sorted by sku. Sum quantity by sku for rows with active === true. Ignore other rows. Each output item is {sku,quantity}. Ignore rows with a missing/non-string sku or non-finite quantity; zero and negative quantities are valid. Do not mutate input.

prompts: Read the first 4000 characters of https://example.com/ using the installed web fetching tool. Save the page title and source URL in source.md. Then implement isAllowedUrl(value) in src/policy.mjs: accept only absolute HTTPS URLs whose hostname is exactly example.com and which have no username/password; allow paths, queries, fragments, and port 443. Reject other protocols, subdomains, non-default ports, invalid input and non-string values. Complete without questions and without installing packages. Work only in this task directory.

Research is complete. Add filterAllowed(values) to src/policy.mjs, retaining allowed URL strings in input order, deduplicated by exact string. Preserve isAllowedUrl and source.md. Complete without questions.
tasks.verify: import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';const {isAllowedUrl:p,filterAllowed:f}=await import('./src/policy.mjs');for(const v of ['https://example.com','https://example.com:443/a?q=x#b'])assert.equal(p(v),true,v);for(const v of ['http://example.com','https://sub.example.com','https://example.com.evil.test','https://a:b@example.com','https://example.com:8443','/relative','not a url',null,42])assert.equal(p(v),false,String(v));assert.deepEqual(f(['https://example.com','http://example.com','https://example.com','https://example.com/a']),['https://example.com','https://example.com/a']);const report=await readFile('source.md','utf8');assert.match(report,/Example Domain/i);assert.ok(report.includes('https://example.com'));
